headline: 4 addresses catalogued across Ethereum; vault addresses for BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon, Avalanche remain undiscovered; ZBT token and two admin addresses confirmed on Ethereum mainnet via Etherscan.

findings.text: D1: Etherscan search for 'ZEROBASE' surfaced ZBT token (0xfAB99fCF605fD8f4593EDb70A43bA56542777777) with 7,516 holders and $75M market cap on Ethereum mainnet; constructor args revealed owner 0xa14f20130E9a0a27D580FD30FD4bbF035a492AB2; source code shows hardcoded MULTISIG constant 0xc8A6772590a00ea34fa53355E5518b4E0fD2BBEf. BscScan name-tag search for ZEROBASE vault contract on BSC mainnet returned no on-chain confirmation; only testnet vault appeared in search results.

D2: Fetched app.zerobase.pro — no canonical deployed-contracts page linked; the app is a single-page React app referencing audit badges (Salus, PeckShield, OpenZeppelin) with no address listing. No deployments doc URL found.

D3: PeckShield audit blob page (GitHub) confirms the PDF title 'PeckShield-Audit-Report-ZeroBase-Vault-v1.0.pdf' (327 KB) but the GitHub blob view does not render PDF content — no in-scope addresses extractable. Salus audit blob page (GitHub) similarly shows 'ZeroBase_report_2024-12-24.pdf' (1.14 MB) without rendered content. OpenZeppelin audit (fetched full page) covers the ZBT token contract at GitHub ZeroBase-Pro/Economics commit 3c55c3f; no vault contract addresses appear in the OZ audit. A second Salus V2 audit for 2025-09-16 is linked from the app site (cert-api.salusec.io) but was not fetched this run.

D4: GitHub org discovered as github.com/ZeroBase-Pro (from OpenZeppelin audit scope referencing ZeroBase-Pro/Economics repo). No protocol.github was pre-pinned. No broadcast/run-latest.json, hardhat-deploy artifacts, or deployment markdown found this run — GitHub repo contents not directly walked due to fetch-limit constraints.

D5: Per-chain enumeration: Ethereum — ZBT token address confirmed; vault address unknown. BSC — vault address not surfaced from bscscan search. Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon, Avalanche — zero addresses surfaced from block-explorer searches (fetch limit reached). DeFiLlama confirms significant TVL on all 7 chains but does not expose individual vault addresses in the TVL stats page snippet.

D6: DeFiLlama adapter description states TVL is calculated by calling getTVL(token) on a vault per chain, implying a vault-per-chain (not factory-children) pattern. No factory address discovered; vault contract addresses per chain remain unknown.

D7: Role taxonomy applied to discovered addresses: ZBT token (token), constructor owner (owner/unknown actor class), MULTISIG constant in token contract (multisig). Vault contracts not yet discovered.
D8: All 4 admin_addresses entries trace to fetched URLs (Etherscan token page for ZBT, OpenZeppelin audit page for testnet owner). No snippet-only sightings placed in admin_addresses.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked the protocol website, both pinned audit blob pages (PeckShield and Salus — PDF content not rendered), the OpenZeppelin token audit (full content), Etherscan for ZBT token, and DeFiLlama TVL page via search. 4 Ethereum addresses catalogued: ZBT token contract, its constructor owner, its hardcoded MULTISIG constant, and the testnet owner from the OZ audit. Vault contract addresses across all 7 chains remain undiscovered due to PDFs not being renderable via blob pages and fetch-limit exhaustion before BSC/multi-chain explorer searches could be completed.

protocol_metadata.about: ZEROBASE CeDeFi is a basis-trading yield protocol that allows users to stake stablecoins (USDT, USDC) to earn risk-neutral returns generated from delta-neutral arbitrage positions on Binance. The protocol also operates a decentralized zero-knowledge proof network where prover nodes must stake stablecoins as collateral; these staked assets are deployed into the basis trade strategy to generate additional returns. ZEROBASE is deployed across seven chains (BSC, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon, Avalanche) with per-chain vault contracts that accept stablecoin deposits and expose a getTVL(token) method for TVL accounting. The ZBT utility token is a LayerZero OFT cross-chain token with a 1-billion-token supply cap per chain.
